title: Changes Service State
description: Lets the input through only when what it watches has changed since the last input — a stream of reports becomes a stream of events. (Runtimes: browser; IDs: hookup.to/service/changes)

bypass.description: When true, the runtime skips this service and passes input straight through.

value.description: An expression over params — what to watch. Empty watches the whole input

emit.description: Which change lets the input through

reset.description: Forgets what was remembered (an action, not state)
